description: Check a goal that is not saved yet against the rubric (a countable metric with value today and target, or a done-or-not result you can check yes or no; deadline within 12 months; pace per week). Changes nothing. Returns problems[] and next_question: loop until problems is empty, then call set_goal. Prefer count; use done only when no honest number exists.

kind.description: count (default): a number from baseline to target, e.g. "15 paying customers". done: a one-time result checked yes or no, e.g. "launch v2 in the stores"; no metric, baseline or target, progress is the share of stages done

metric.description: the one number and its unit, e.g. "paying customers"

name: check_goal_draft
title: Check goal draft
